title: Aromatic Uruguayan Ham Stew
description: A spicy, glassy-jelly ham stew cooked in a clay pot that is kid-friendly and Whole30 compliant.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: red bell pepper, carrot, potato diced

instructions: Heat a clay pot over medium heat and add olive oil.
Sauté the diced onion until translucent, about 4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the mixed vegetables and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Mix in tomato puree, ham stock, smoked paprika, cumin, cayenne, and cubed ham, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot and transfer to the oven; bake for 45 minutes until the broth thickens into a glassy glaze.
Remove the pot, stir in salt and pepper to taste, and let it rest for 5 minutes.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.
Serve hot with crusty bread or rice.
